name: Entity Count
description: Builds an admin report of the number of entities per type/bundle. NOTE: counts include entities the viewer can't access.
project_description:
Simple module that reports the count for each entity type. Also reports the count and information per bundle. Useful when keeping track on the number of entities that are currently stored in the database and for performance reasons.

 Usage 
 Under "Administration > Reports" you will find the "Entity count" link. 

 Click on it to get a list of entity types, their count and, if the type has more than one bundle, a per bundle report.
